nodes.label: Future Mobile API Contract
nodes.rationale: TZ §76/§77. Records backend readiness only — no mobile code is written here — so the mobile team does not have to re-derive the backend shape when it starts.

nodes.label: TranslationRules Locale Model
nodes.rationale: No single-field `title` exists; every translation is a separate row with UNIQUE(parent_id, locale), so adding a language needs only a new Locale enum value, not a migration.

nodes.label: Locale Resolution Order
nodes.rationale: Request ?lang= wins, then cms_user_account.language, then UZ. Push notifications use only the profile language because there is no request to read.

nodes.label: Modelled But Unopened Endpoints
nodes.rationale: Catalog, content page, search (indexes V21/V23 ready), profile, purchases, comments, ads and /app/auth/** OTP login are modelled in the schema but not exposed yet.

nodes.label: Content ID Stability Guarantee
nodes.rationale: Verified, not assumed: IDs stay Long/IDENTITY (IdStrategyTest §57), are never reused, and content is archived rather than removed (SoftDeleteTest §58).

nodes.label: Slug Is Not Stable
nodes.rationale: Admins can edit the slug, so it is a human-readable address only. Any saved list must key on content_id; keying on slug would break a user's saved items whenever an admin renames content. HomeFeedDto.ContentCard already returns both id and slug.

nodes.label: user_watchlist Future Table
nodes.rationale: 'Watch later' (TZ §77) needs no admin page and no table yet — an empty table would be needless. When added it is just (user_id, content_id) with a unique pair, and the listing must filter archived content so a saved film does not become an unopenable row.

nodes.label: Bunny Stream Video Decision Pending
nodes.rationale: The client proposed delivering video through Bunny Stream ('the server is a turnstile, not a pipe' — no byte passes through the VPS), which contradicts the current local storage + chunked upload + Range design. Video code was deliberately left unchanged until the answer arrives; if accepted, /api/v1/app/watch/* gains a signed HLS link and the app pulls straight from the CDN.

nodes.label: Mobile-Facing Backend Decisions
nodes.rationale: Money is BigDecimal/tiyin because floating point is never used for money (§36); time is Asia/Tashkent (§68); device-limit entity exists but is not enforced until the app connects; unconnected payment providers never return a fake success (§44); FCM writes notifications but does not send, reporting null rather than 0.
